basic_info.description: BEST VALUE in South Beach! Rarely available and truly one-of-a-kind, this stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom top-floor corner unit is nestled in one of San Francisco's iconic landmark buildings. This single-level home seamlessly blends contemporary finishes with historic charm, featuring an exposed brick wall and steel accents.    The open-concept living and dining area is flooded with natural light from expansive windows. The newly updated chef's kitchen boasts brand-new appliances, sleek quartz countertops, abundant storage, and elegant finishes, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The beautifully remodeled bathroom offers a stylish palette of finishes. Additional features include a spacious and light filled bedroom with ample closet space, in-unit laundry, designer light fixtures, new carpet in the bedroom, and a designated parking space. Ideally situated near the Embarcadero waterfront, the Ferry Building, premier shopping and dining, and Oracle Park. With easy access to CalTrain, BART, MUNI, and major highways, this location offers the best of San Francisco living.
